newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed on higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed on higher turnover.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday on a higher volume and turnover and traders said market developments would depend on the moves of a few big investors.
"Prices will depend on the behaviour of big investors who become active at intervals," a trader from Metroholding brokerage told Reuters.
He said food processor Podravka, one of the most attractive shares on the market, was particularly sensitive to fluctuations in the investors' interest due to its huge offer.
Podravka edged down three kuna to 212, selling 150 units.
Of eight active issues, two were up, three down and three remained unchanged.
Both volume and turnover rose, signalling a recovery might be on cards, but traders predicted slow trade for the rest of the month.
Hotelier Laguna, the bigger of today's two gainers, added 60 kuna to 1,100 on a volume of 130 shares.
Blue chip Zagrebacka Banka, adding 10 kuna to close 990, accounted for most of today's trading with 5,626 shares sold.
